title: Record product skill patch decision request
description: Immutable ACCEPT or REJECT decision bound to one exact interaction, patch and base draft. Request-attempt identity is carried only in HTTP headers for safe replay with new attempt IDs.
x-invariants: path session_id, interaction_id and patch_id equal the request fields
interaction session_id and turn_id equal the request and embedded AgentTurnFeedback identities
interaction skill_patch patch_id, patch_sha256, draft_id, skill_id, base revision, base hash and result hash equal the request
expected_interaction_revision equals the current undecided interaction revision
one patch has at most one immutable terminal decision
ACCEPT atomically validates and applies the patch, advances the draft exactly once, records the decision, advances interaction_revision exactly once and persists the idempotency receipt
REJECT atomically records the decision and advances interaction_revision exactly once without changing the draft
any identity, revision, hash, policy or patch-application failure writes nothing
one idempotency scope is tenant_id plus actor_id plus operationId plus canonical path plus Idempotency-Key
same key and byte-equivalent body replays the original status and receipt; different body returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED
